User Story: As a trader, I want to type a ticker in the sidebar and add it, so it appears in my watchlist and loads.
Expected Behaviour: Entering 'AAPL' + '+' (or Enter) POSTs /api/symbols, downloads data, adds to sidebar, and selects it. Empty input is ignored; duplicates show an info toast.
Test Method: API harness (POST /api/symbols valid/empty/dupe); JS flow review
Errors Found: None (live Yahoo fetch blocked by env network policy — fetch path returns graceful error toast)

User Story: As a trader, I want to paste several comma/space-separated tickers and have them imported together.
Expected Behaviour: Input with >1 token routes to the Bulk Import modal pre-filled with the tickers.

User Story: As a trader, I want to paste a list of tickers and import them with a progress bar.
Expected Behaviour: Modal validates tickers (regex ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9.\-^]{0,9}$), dedupes, skips existing, shows per-ticker progress, summary toast, auto-closes on full success.

User Story: As a trader, I want to remove a ticker via the × button.
Expected Behaviour: DELETE /api/symbols/<sym> removes symbol+OHLCV; if it was active, view returns to empty state.
Errors Found: showEmptyState() did not hide knn-area/backtest-area, so removing the active symbol while on KNN or Backtest tab left stale content overlapping the empty state.
Fix Applied: app.js: showEmptyState() now hides knn-area and backtest-area too.

User Story: As a trader, I want to tag a ticker with a group name and edit it inline.
Expected Behaviour: Clicking the tag badge opens an inline input; Enter/blur PUTs /api/symbols/<sym>/group; Escape cancels.

User Story: As a trader, I want my watchlist grouped by tag with headers.
Expected Behaviour: Symbols sorted by group_tag (ungrouped last) then symbol; group headers render on group change.
Test Method: API harness (list ordering) + JS render review

User Story: As a trader, I want clicking a ticker to load it in whichever tab I'm viewing.
Expected Behaviour: selectSymbol routes to charts/stats/knn/backtest(header only)/trend loaders based on active tab.

User Story: As a trader, I want to refresh all watchlist data at once.
Expected Behaviour: POST /api/refresh fetches all symbols concurrently and reloads the active chart; per-symbol toasts.
Test Method: Endpoint review (live fetch blocked by env)

User Story: As a trader, I want to collapse the sidebar to widen the chart.
Expected Behaviour: ☰ toggles .sidebar-collapsed; button glyph switches ☰/▶.

User Story: As a user, I want a live clock in the top bar.
Expected Behaviour: Updates every second with date+time, 24h format.

User Story: As a trader, I want side-by-side daily and weekly candlestick charts.
Expected Behaviour: Both panels render candles from /api/ohlcv; cross-panel date range stays in sync.

User Story: As a trader, I want to add a KAMA period (2–500) and see it on both panels.
Expected Behaviour: Validates range; adds pill + live series; fetches indicators with new kama param.
Test Method: API harness (indicators kama param + bad kama 400); JS review

User Story: As a trader, I want to click a KAMA pill to show/hide that line.
Expected Behaviour: Toggling updates overlay visibility on both panels and pill styling.

User Story: As a trader, I want to right-click a KAMA pill to remove it.
Expected Behaviour: Removes series from both charts, re-renders pills, re-fetches if a symbol is loaded.

User Story: As a trader, I want to toggle Bollinger Bands.
Expected Behaviour: Bol. Bands pill toggles upper/mid/lower visibility on both panels.
Test Method: API harness (bb_* keys present); JS review

User Story: As a trader, I want an RSI pane with 7/14/21 lines and OB/OS guides.
Expected Behaviour: RSI lines render with 80/50/20 reference lines.

User Story: As a trader, I want a MACD pane (12/26/9) with histogram colored by sign.
Expected Behaviour: macd_line/signal/hist render; histogram green/red by sign.

User Story: As a trader, I want a composite trend-score pane (-3..+3).
Expected Behaviour: trend_score histogram renders colored by sign with a zero reference line.

User Story: As a trader, I want sub-charts and panels to stay aligned when I pan/zoom or resize.
Expected Behaviour: Within-panel logical-range sync; cross-panel date sync; charts resize with container.
Errors Found: ResizeObserver instances created on every chart rebuild were never disconnected; stale observers fired chart.resize() on disposed charts (console errors + observer leak across reloads).
Fix Applied: charts.js: track observers in _chartObservers, disconnect them in destroyCharts(), and guard resize() in try/catch with size>0 check.

User Story: As a trader, I want a symbol with no stored data to auto-download when I open its chart.
Expected Behaviour: On 404/No data, the UI fetches then retries the chart load.
Test Method: Endpoint 404 path verified; JS retry review

User Story: As a trader, I want the header to show last price, change, and OHLCV strip.
Expected Behaviour: Header shows price, +/- change & %, and open/high/low/close/volume (volume humanized B/M).

User Story: As a trader, I want volatility, Sharpe, max drawdown, and win rate KPIs.
Expected Behaviour: /api/stats metrics populate 4 KPI cards; flat series degrades gracefully (no crash).

User Story: As a quant, I want RSI-decile forward-return bar charts.

User Story: As a quant, I want a histogram of daily returns.
Expected Behaviour: 30-bin distribution renders.

User Story: As a quant, I want average monthly returns.

User Story: As a quant, I want KAMA-distance decile forward-return charts for K10/20/50.

User Story: As a trader, I want daily or weekly trend computation.

User Story: As a trader, I want to toggle each baseline/band on the chart.

User Story: As a trader, I want to tune ER/slow/confirm/RSI params and apply presets.
Expected Behaviour: Config inputs feed query params; Smoother/Default/Faster presets update and re-apply.
Test Method: API harness (config params parsed); JS review

User Story: As a trader, I want a composite signal, per-horizon states, entry, stop/TP levels, and R:R.
Expected Behaviour: Composite (-3..+3) badge, strength dots, S/M/L cards, last entry, MRT/SDB/MDB, R:R (only when in a medium regime), date-alignment warning.

User Story: As a trader, I want to scan the whole watchlist for trend signal, RSI, KAMA distances, R:R, stop/target.
Expected Behaviour: /api/trend-scan computes per-symbol metrics; sortable table; click symbol loads its chart.
Test Method: API harness (5 rows, signals); JS sort/render review

User Story: As a trader, I want D/W/M technical metrics (RSI, KAMA ratios, momentum, volatility, trend) per symbol.
Expected Behaviour: /api/scanner computes per-symbol D/W/M metrics; color-coded heatmap cells.
Test Method: API harness (5 rows; daily metrics populated; monthly via ME)
Errors Found: Monthly resample used .agg(**agg) (pandas named-aggregation) which always raised TypeError on the 'ME' alias and silently fell back to the deprecated 'M' alias (FutureWarning spam; breaks on future pandas).
Fix Applied: scanner.py _to_monthly: pass agg dict positionally (.agg(agg)) so 'ME' works cleanly.

User Story: As a trader, I want to show/hide RSI/KAMA/Momentum/Volatility/Trend column groups.
Expected Behaviour: Group buttons toggle column visibility and re-render the table.

User Story: As a trader, I want to sort by any metric and timeframe.
Expected Behaviour: Clicking a header sorts asc/desc; nulls sink to bottom.

User Story: As a trader, I want a -5..+5 composite bull/bear score per symbol.
Expected Behaviour: Weighted daily+weekly score computed and color-coded.

User Story: As a trader, I want to (re)scan the watchlist and click a symbol to open its chart.
Expected Behaviour: Scan All refreshes via /api/scanner; symbol cell click calls selectSymbol.

Test Method: API harness (all negative cases) + unit tests

Expected Behaviour: init_db migrations idempotent; upsert dedupes by (symbol,freq,date); incremental fetch from last date.

User Story: As a user, I want the app served at / .
Expected Behaviour: GET / serves index.html; static assets served from root.

User Story: As a user, I want real OHLCV downloaded from Yahoo Finance.
Expected Behaviour: yfinance downloads daily history, resamples weekly/monthly, stores to DB.
Errors Found: Yahoo Finance hosts (query1/query2.finance.yahoo.com) are not in this sandbox's network allowlist, so live downloads return HTTP 403. This is an environment egress restriction, NOT an application defect; the code handles the failure gracefully (error toast / error JSON).
Fix Applied: No code change — add Yahoo hosts to the environment network policy to enable live data.
